photos.title: File:Khao Sok, Asian noodle soup, Surat Thani, Thailand.jpg
photos.description: Thai/Chinese style noodle soup. A wonderfully warming Asian noodle soup: rice noodles with fragrant spices and coconut milk, ginger, chilli, lemongrass, garlic and coriander. Sugar, nam pla (fish sauce), dried chilli and chilli in vinegar provided in jars on the table. Surat Thani, Thailand.
